gvalid_nested_customer_profile.description: G_valid simple object with nested required profile, no AP:false/unevaluated* so that Generator can satisfy required properties without structural Repair.

nongvalid_ap_false_unevaluated_object.description: Non-G_valid object with AP:false and unevaluatedProperties:false used to verify that AP:false/unevaluated* motifs stay outside the G_valid zone and keep legacy behaviour.

gvalid_minprops_enum_object.description: G_valid simple object that exercises minProperties and enum/const bounds; no AP:false/unevaluated* so Generator must satisfy bounds without Repair.

gvalid_unsat_enum_const_object.description: G_valid simple object made intentionally unsatisfiable (const vs enum conflict) to assert clear diagnostics and pipeline failure without relying on Repair.
